display.purpose: Display headlines and hero titles with tight tracking.

body.purpose: Readable paragraphs, explanations, and controls with relaxed leading.

shadows.name: panel-shadow
shadows.purpose: Soft downward shadow under white panel cards.

motion.name: interaction
motion.purpose: Default duration and easing for button hover and disclosure toggles.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Electric-blue action button with subtle hover lift and press return.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background-color: #074ce0; color: #ffffff; padding: 10px 20px; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; border-radius: 8px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms ease-out, background-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: #0640bf; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Pale outlined secondary button with hairline border and soft hover background.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background-color: #ffffff; color: #16191f; padding: 10px 18px; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #dde0e6; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms ease-out, background-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background-color: #f3f4f6; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Panel Card
components.description: White surface container with 12px radius, hairline border, and soft downward shadow.
components.html:
Threat Assessment

Deterministic rule analysis results.
components.css: .ds-panel { background-color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #dde0e6; border-radius: 12px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px -1px rgba(22, 25, 31, 0.04); } .ds-panel-title { font-family: 'Host Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; color: #16191f; margin: 0 0 8px 0; } .ds-panel-body { font-family: 'Instrument Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; color: #454c58; line-height: 1.6; margin: 0; }

narrative.overview: ScamShield Bharat pairs an open, crisp light reading surface with an electric-blue action color and two substantial dark passages. The system prioritizes clarity and immediate comprehension for citizens under stress who may have received a frightening fraud notification.
keyCharacteristics: Open Light Foundation: Clean near-white page (#fcfcfd) with pale-grey secondary groupings (#f3f4f6).
Electric-Blue Focus: High-contrast electric blue (#074ce0) dedicated to meaningful user actions.
Dual Dark Passages: Two continuous dark fields (#16191f) framing the analysis architecture and closing incident triage.
Editorial Typography: Display and title type in Host Grotesk paired with relaxed-leading Instrument Sans.

rules.name: The Single-Accent Rule
rules.body: Electric blue (#074ce0) is reserved strictly for primary interactive actions and the central engine node.

rules.name: The Legibility-First Rule
rules.body: Body text maintains a minimum line-height of 1.6 and strict WCAG AAA contrast ratio.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: All panels and cards rest flat against the surface. Subtle elevation is activated only during hover interactions.

dos: Do preserve the 1.45:1 hero split and converging diagram composition.
Do maintain the two continuous #16191f dark passages for the analysis architecture and the footer.
Do honor reduced motion preferences via @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce).
Do preserve full trilingual localization parity across English, Hindi, and Gujarati.
donts: Don't add animated bounce, elastic easings, or gimmicky particle loops.
Don't use electric blue as a full-page background or decorative wash.
Don't fabricate claims, verified threat intelligence feeds, or artificial endorsements.
Don't automatically open or ping untrusted URLs entered by users.
